narrative.details:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
narrative.offerRewardText: By the Light... it looks just like his boy... <Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.> This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength. It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead. Thank you, champion. Light bless you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Light be with you, champion. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
